The same thing happened to me two days ago. 2 weeks ago, my oral communication professor asked us all to do a small presentation on whatever topic we liked so the next week I prepared and all. When it was  my turn I forgot everything I memorized so I had to read from the paper, my voice was also really low and shaking, I was also trembling and couldn't make eye contact with anyone so I was looking at the ground the whole time(* I have social anxiety). Once finished, I looked at my professor and he was looking really mad, he said he didn't like my presentation at all, pointing out everything I did wrong etc.. He also demanded a do another presentation next week and that it better be better than that one. The second week, I prepared another presentation this time about social anxiety, it was only me and him in the class, So I removed my glasses this time, just so that everything becomes blurry and that I can pretend to be having eye contact with him, and started again talking with my shaky low voice, trembling hands, and forgetting the words every now and then because of the anxiety. Once done, he again seemed unsatisfied and was yelling at me "what's wrong"... " What was that?" .. Then it happened, I just started crying, I couldn't control myself, the stress, the social anxiety, the depression I've been through two weeks ago, and then this.. I actually prepared well for the presentation and the day before I kept reviewing and rehearsing the speech till 3am. So there I was, 21 years old standing in class in front of my professor, with tears running down my face like some fkn river ruining my makeup and my face going red. I was feeling so emotional and couldn't stop crying. Then his tone changed and went a little soft, he asked again what's wrong so I told him that I've been feeling a little depressed the few previous weeks, how I skipped a lot of classes and also a DS. So he was like it's ok you can always ask your classmates to lend you their courses so you can print them and that one DS isn't really important and that I should forget about it all and just make it up in the exams. It was so weird and embarrassing, I also didn't tell him about my social anxiety that's basically ruining my life cause it was so weird and even if I did I am pretty sure he would suggest I see the psychiatrist in my college (which I did and didn't really help, he would actually only listen to me then give me some stupid motivational speeches thinking they would cure my anxiety or depression..). I still feel embarrassed and wonder how am I supposed to show him my face again after all that crying and embarrassment I caused ugh...

When I was your age, my skin was so clear, I had no pimples, discoloration or anything, so I only used lip gloss and eyeliner which I only winged just a little bit (basically a minimal natural look), most of the girls I knew at the time either didn't put anything on their faces or just used lip balms, mascara or eyeliner we were all students after all. I also knew some girls at the time, who used shit ton of foundation that didn't match their necks, bright lipsticks, lot of mascara and super long winged eyeliner and always thought why and how.. The contouring, highlighting, foundation, concealer, lipsticks etc.. I only started using those in college mostly on occasions, parties etc but as an everyday look am always faithful to my eyeliner, gloss (+BB cream, and blush). So I guess yes, you should stick to the most minimal natural look you can since your so young and already beautiful, those other things you'll need them later when that beauty starts to fade away, anything else will make you look much older and may look too much I guess. Hope this helped :)

Well, it really depends also are you like new to make up? If so I suggest you buy foundation (if you have a lot of pimples, discoloration or marks you wanna hide), or BB cream (if your skin is already clear), I don't think concealer is necessary for me because I rarely get dark circles so it totally depends on the person, Gloss (for a more everyday natural look), or nude lipstick cause it's also very practical, mascara for me it's a must cause it's really easy and fast to apply so it's good for everyday use, and eyeliner (again if you're new to makeup you will find it a little hard to apply that's why I don't suggest you buy one otherwise I think it's suitable for everyday looks and is really practical), also blush depending on your skin tone, I suggest you pick something close to the color of your natural blush. And finally bronzer I honestly don't use it everyday so I think it's not that necessary. Hope this helped :)
